title: Actions related to transmission of SCGFailureInformation message

entities.name: SCGFailureInformation message
entities.description: RRC message sent by UE to report secondary cell group (SCG) failure events to the network.

entities.name: Timer T310
entities.description: Timer used for radio link failure detection in SCG.

entities.name: Timer T312
entities.description: Timer used for SCG failure detection.

entities.name: failureType
entities.description: IE indicating the type of SCG failure that triggered the SCGFailureInformation message.

entities.name: failureType-v1610
entities.description: Extended failure type IE for additional failure scenarios introduced in later specifications.

entities.name: MeasResultSCG-Failure
entities.description: IE containing measurement results for SCG frequencies configured by SCG RRC signaling.

entities.name: measResultFreqList
entities.description: List containing measurement results per frequency for MCG-configured measurement objects.

entities.name: T310 expiry condition
entities.description: Condition where timer T310 expires, indicating SCG radio link failure.

entities.name: T312 expiry condition
entities.description: Condition where timer T312 expires, indicating SCG failure.

entities.name: Beam failure recovery condition
entities.description: Condition where random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery.

entities.name: Set failureType property
entities.description: UE action to set the failureType IE based on the specific SCG failure condition.

relations.description: SCGFailureInformation message contains the failureType IE.
SCGFailureInformation message contains the failureType-v1610 IE for extended failure types.
T310 expiry condition establishes the property to set failureType as t310-Expiry.
T312 expiry condition establishes the property to set failureType as other and failureType-v1610 as t312-Expiry.
Beam failure recovery condition establishes the property to set failureType as other and failureType-v1610 as beamFailureRecoveryFailure.
failureType IE value is guarded by T310 expiry condition.
failureType-v1610 IE value is guarded by T312 expiry condition.
failureType-v1610 IE value is guarded by beam failure recovery condition.
